claim: A study of Henan’s July 2021 extreme precipitation identifies three moisture-transport routes, involving the western Pacific subtropical high (WPSH), the WPSH with Typhoon In-Fa, and the WPSH with Typhoon Cempaka. It reports that southern China supplied 38.1% of moisture sources and the western North Pacific 30.0%; the WPSH–In-Fa route had the highest moistening and precipitating efficiency.
reason: S2 abstract states the three routes (WPSH; WPSH with In-Fa; WPSH with Cempaka), 38.1% from southern China, 30.0% from western North Pacific, and WPSH-In-Fa highest efficiency. All match.
